events.title: 토트넘 홋스퍼 sign Belgian striker Nico Claesen from 스탕다르 리에주 Liège for £600,000.
셰필드 웬즈데이 go fourth in the First Division with a 6–1 home win over 옥스퍼드 유나이티드. An all-London clash at Selhurst Park sees 크리스털 팰리스 go top of the Second Division with a 2–1 win over 밀월.
루턴 타운 lose an appeal against their expulsion from the League Cup.

Newly promoted 노리치 시티 top the league after a 0–0 away draw with 루턴 타운. 노팅엄 포리스트 fall into second after a 3–1 defeat to East Midlands rivals 레스터 시티 at Filbert Street . 웨스트햄 유나이티드 go fourth with a 5–3 home win over 첼시. 포츠머스 go top of the Second Division with a 2–0 win over Birmingham at Fratton Park .
맨체스터 유나이티드 sign 18-year-old Irish midfielder Liam O'Brien from Shamrock Rovers for £60,000.
England open their 1988 European Championship qualifying campaign with a 3–0 win over Northern Ireland at Wembley .
퀸스 파크 레인저스 put defender Terry Fenwick on the transfer list at his own request . The former 에버턴 goalkeeper Ted Sagar dies aged 76.

노팅엄 포리스트 return to the top of the First Division with a 1–0 home win over 퀸스 파크 레인저스. 노리치 시티 surrender top position with a 1–1 draw at home to 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 리버풀 keep up the pressure on the leading pair with a 4–0 home win over 옥스퍼드 유나이티드.
Out of favour 맨체스터 유나이티드 defender John Gidman joins neighbours City on a free transfer.
노리치 시티 sign 22-year-old goalkeeper Bryan Gunn for £150,000 from Aberdeen .

Mike Newell , a former 리버풀 trainee, scores a hat-trick in 루턴 타운's 4–1 league win over the double winners at Kenilworth Road. Colin Clarke scores his second hat-trick for 사우샘프턴 in a 3–2 away win over 레스터 시티. 노팅엄 포리스트 remain top despite losing 2–1 to 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 at the Manor Ground as both 노리치 시티 and 리버풀 lose, while 에버턴 go third with a 3–2 home win over 왓퍼드.
The only competitive action of the day is the Manchester derby at Maine Road , which ends in a 1–1 draw. City climb off the bottom of the table on goal difference at the expense of 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.
In the third round of the League Cup, Fourth Division club 카디프 시티 upset First Division 첼시 while Second Division 입스위치 타운 are knocked out by Fourth Division team 케임브리지 유나이티드 .

October ends with 노팅엄 포리스트 back on top of the First Division, one point ahead of 노리치 시티 and two ahead of 에버턴 and 아스널. 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 애스턴 빌라 have both climbed out of the bottom two, ahead of 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, 맨체스터 시티 and 첼시. 포츠머스 are now leaders of the Second Division, a point ahead of 올덤 애슬레틱. 리즈 유나이티드, 플리머스 아가일 and 선덜랜드 occupy the playoff places.
